articles.summary: Fluor Corporation (NYSE: FLR) announced today that its JGC Fluor BC LNG II joint venture with JGC Corporation (JFJV2) has received limited notice to proceed (LNTP) for the proposed Phase 2 expansion of the LNG Canada export facility in Kitimat, British Columbia, Canada. The LNG Canada export facility in Kitimat, British Columbia, Canada. The same joint venture partners (JFJV) played a central role in delivering Phase 1 of LNG Canada, providing engineering, procurement, fabrication management, construction and commissioning services. In 2025, JFJV successfully delivered the project’s two processing units, known as trains, and supporting infrastructure including storage tanks, rail yard, water treatment facility, flare stacks and marine terminal. “Our long‑standing partnership with LNG Canada is a point of pride for us, and we look forward to advancing the next phase of this world‑class project to help connect Canadian natural gas to global markets,” said Pierre Bechelany, Fluor’s
articles.title: Fluor Joint Venture Receives Limited Notice to Proceed for Proposed Phase 2 Expansion of LNG Canada Facility
